# Data
```{r}


famines <- read.csv("../processed data/famine_region_data.csv") %>% mutate(Decade = floor(Year/10)*10) %>% 
  #sort years within region
  arrange(Region, Year) 


fishprice <- read.csv('../processed data/fishprice_enso.csv') %>% 
  mutate(Decade = floor(Year / 10) * 10) %>%
  dplyr::select(LocationSpecies,Year, Decade, everything()) %>% 
  #create a logprice_diff variable
  arrange(LocationSpecies, Year) %>%
  group_by(LocationSpecies) %>%
  mutate(logprice_diff = logprice - lag(logprice)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

price <- read.csv('../processed data/price_2023_enso.csv')
#put Location and Year as first columns
price <- price %>% 
    mutate(Decade = floor(Year / 10) * 10) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Location,Year,Decade, everything()) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(Location, Year) %>% 
  group_by(Location) %>%
  mutate(logprice_diff = logprice - lag(logprice)) %>%
  ungroup()




```



# NAO JSL

```{r}
#-----------------------
# Prepare + standardize
#-----------------------
ts_data <- fishprice %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    ENSO = mean(nino34, na.rm = TRUE),
    NAO  = mean(NAO_cal, na.rm = TRUE),
    JSL  = mean(JSL, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(ENSO, NAO, JSL), scale))

#-----------------------
# Correlations
#-----------------------
cor_nao <- cor.test(ts_data$ENSO, ts_data$NAO)
cor_jsl <- cor.test(ts_data$ENSO, ts_data$JSL)

lab_nao <- sprintf("r = %.2f, p = %.3f", cor_nao$estimate, cor_nao$p.value)
lab_jsl <- sprintf("r = %.2f, p = %.3f", cor_jsl$estimate, cor_jsl$p.value)

#-----------------------
# Time series data
#-----------------------
df_ts <- ts_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, ENSO, NAO, JSL) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "var", values_to = "value")

df_nao <- df_ts %>% filter(var %in% c("ENSO", "NAO"))
df_jsl <- df_ts %>% filter(var %in% c("ENSO", "JSL"))

#-----------------------
# Time series plots
#-----------------------
base_ts <- theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

p_nao <- ggplot(df_nao, aes(Year, value, color = var)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(ENSO = "black", NAO = "tomato")) +
  labs(
    title = "a. ENSO vs NAO",
    y = "Standardized index",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(ts_data$Year),
           y = max(df_nao$value, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = lab_nao,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           size = 4) +
  base_ts

p_jsl <- ggplot(df_jsl, aes(Year, value, color = var)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(ENSO = "black", JSL = "cornflowerblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "b. ENSO vs JSL",
    y = "Standardized index",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(ts_data$Year),
           y = max(df_jsl$value, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = lab_jsl,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           size = 4) +
  base_ts

# Stack them vertically (left panel)
panel_A <- p_nao / p_jsl + plot_annotation(theme = theme(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
))

#-----------------------
# IRF estimation helper
#-----------------------
run_irfs <- function(data_in, var, controls_full, controls_base,
                     label, dataset_name, panel_id, fe) {

  bind_rows(
    lp_panel(data = data_in, outcome = "logprice", main_var = var,
             controls = controls_full, horizon = 10, fe = fe,
             panel_id = panel_id, vcov = DK ~ Year) %>%
      mutate(shock = label, spec = "Controlling", dataset = dataset_name),

    lp_panel(data = data_in, outcome = "logprice", main_var = var,
             controls = controls_base, horizon = 10, fe = fe,
             panel_id = panel_id, vcov = DK ~ Year) %>%
      mutate(shock = label, spec = "Total", dataset = dataset_name)
  )
}

#-----------------------
# Specs
#-----------------------
shocks <- tribble(
  ~var, ~label, ~excl,
  "nino34",  "ENSO", "NAO_cal + JSL",
  "NAO_cal", "NAO",  "nino34 + JSL",
  "JSL",     "JSL",  "nino34 + NAO_cal"
) %>%
  mutate(
    controls_full = "1",
    controls_base = "1"
  )

datasets <- list(
  list(data = fishprice, name = "Fish",   panel_id = c("LocationSpecies","Year"), fe = "LocationSpecies + Decade"),
  list(data = price,     name = "Grains", panel_id = c("Location","Year"),        fe = "Location + Decade")
)

#-----------------------
# Run IRFs
#-----------------------
irf_all <- map_dfr(datasets, function(d) {
  pmap_dfr(shocks, function(var, label, excl, controls_full, controls_base) {
    run_irfs(d$data, var, controls_full, controls_base, label, d$name, d$panel_id, d$fe)
  })
}) %>%
  mutate(
    shock = factor(shock, levels = c("ENSO","NAO","JSL")),
    spec  = factor(spec, levels = c("Total","Controlling"))
  )

#-----------------------
# IRF plot (right panel)
#-----------------------
p_irf <- ggplot(irf_all, aes(horizon, irf_mean, color = spec)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = irf_down, ymax = irf_up, fill = spec), alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  facet_grid(dataset ~ shock) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("dodgerblue", "#E84545")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("dodgerblue", "#E84545")) +
  labs(
    title = "c. Impulse responses",
    x = "Horizon (years)",
    y = "Effect on log prices"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

#-----------------------
# Final combined figure
#-----------------------
final_plot <- panel_A | p_irf +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2)) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
    )
  )

final_plot
```


```{r}
#-----------------------
# Prepare + standardize
#-----------------------
ts_data <- fishprice %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    ENSO = mean(nino34, na.rm = TRUE),
    NAO  = mean(NAO_cal, na.rm = TRUE),
    JSL  = mean(JSL, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(c(ENSO, NAO, JSL), scale))

#-----------------------
# Correlations
#-----------------------
cor_nao <- cor.test(ts_data$ENSO, ts_data$NAO)
cor_jsl <- cor.test(ts_data$ENSO, ts_data$JSL)

lab_nao <- paste0(
  "r = ", sprintf("%.2f", cor_nao$estimate),
  ", p = ", sprintf("%.3f", cor_nao$p.value)
)

lab_jsl <- paste0(
  "r = ", sprintf("%.2f", cor_jsl$estimate),
  ", p = ", sprintf("%.3f", cor_jsl$p.value)
)

#-----------------------
# Reshape for two panels
#-----------------------
df_nao <- ts_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, ENSO, NAO) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "var", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(panel = "ENSO vs NAO")

df_jsl <- ts_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, ENSO, JSL) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "var", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(panel = "ENSO vs JSL")

df_all <- bind_rows(df_nao, df_jsl)

#-----------------------
# Plot
#-----------------------
ggplot(df_all, aes(Year, value, color = var)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "ENSO" = "black",
    "NAO"  = "tomato",
    "JSL"  = "cornflowerblue"
  )) +
  
  facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 1) +
  
  annotate("text",
           x = min(ts_data$Year),
           y = max(df_all$value, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = lab_nao,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           size = 4) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Standardized Index",
    color = ""
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## Prices

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}


# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
COL_TOTAL <- "dodgerblue"          # deep navy-black
COL_CTRL  <- "#E84545"          # vivid red



# ── Helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_irfs <- function(data_in, var, controls_full, controls_base,
                     label, dataset_name, panel_id, fe) {
  bind_rows(
    lp_panel(data = data_in, outcome = "logprice", main_var = var,
             controls = controls_full, horizon = 10, fe = fe,
             panel_id = panel_id, vcov = DK ~ Year) %>%
      mutate(shock = label, spec = "Controlling for NAO/ENSO/JSL", dataset = dataset_name),
    lp_panel(data = data_in, outcome = "logprice", main_var = var,
             controls = controls_base, horizon = 10, fe = fe,
             panel_id = panel_id, vcov = DK ~ Year) %>%
      mutate(shock = label, spec = "Total effect", dataset = dataset_name)
  )
}

# ── Specs table (no repetition) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
shocks <- tribble(
  ~var,       ~label,  ~excl,
  "nino34",   "ENSO",  "NAO_cal + JSL",
  "NAO_cal",  "NAO",   "nino34 + JSL",
  "JSL",      "JSL",   "nino34 + NAO_cal"
) %>%
  mutate(
    controls_full = glue::glue("{excl} + 1"),
    controls_base = glue::glue("1")
  )

datasets <- list(
  list(data = fishprice, name = "Fish",   panel_id = c("LocationSpecies","Year"), fe = "LocationSpecies + Decade"),
  list(data = price,     name = "Grains", panel_id = c("Location","Year"),        fe = "Location + Decade")
)

# ── Run ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
irf_all <- map_dfr(datasets, function(d) {
  pmap_dfr(shocks, function(var, label, excl, controls_full, controls_base) {
    run_irfs(d$data, var, controls_full, controls_base, label, d$name, d$panel_id, d$fe)
  })
}) %>%
  mutate(
    shock   = factor(shock,   levels = c("ENSO","NAO","JSL")),
    spec    = factor(spec,    levels = c("Total effect","Controlling for NAO/ENSO/JSL")),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("Fish","Grains")),
    panel   = {
      idx   <- as.integer(dataset) * 3 - 3 + as.integer(shock)
      label <- paste0(dataset, " \u2014 ", shock)
      paste0("", letters[idx], ".  ", label)    # e.g. "(a)  Fish — ENSO"
    }
  )

# ── Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(irf_all, aes(horizon, irf_mean, color = spec, fill = spec, linetype = spec)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = irf_down, ymax = irf_up), alpha = 0.13, color = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2), expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.07, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values    = c(COL_TOTAL, COL_CTRL)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values     = c(COL_TOTAL, COL_CTRL)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed")) +
  labs(
    x = "Horizon (years)",
    y = "Impulse response of log prices"
  ) +
  guides(
    color    = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.4, alpha = 1)),
    fill     = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 0.2)),
    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.4))
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  #out legend at bottom, facet title are bold font not frame
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


```



# Non Linearity


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}

# Linear
m_lin <- feols(
  f(logprice, 1) - l(logprice, 1) ~ 
    nino34 + 
    i(Decade) | Location,
  data = data,
  panel.id = c("Location", "Year"),
  vcov = DK ~ Year
)

# Quadratic
m_p2 <- feols(
  f(logprice, 1) - l(logprice, 1) ~  poly(nino34,2,raw=T) + 
    i(Decade) | Location,
  data = data,
  panel.id = c("Location", "Year"),
  vcov = DK ~ Year
)

# Cubic
m_p3 <- feols(
  f(logprice, 1) - l(logprice, 1) ~ poly(nino34,3,raw=T) +
    i(Decade) | Location,
  data = data,
  panel.id = c("Location", "Year"),
  vcov = DK ~ Year
)

# Helper to generate predictions over a grid
make_pred <- function(model, label) {
  useful::predict_poly(
    model, "nino34",
    min = -1, max = 2,
    ref = 0, step.length = 0.01,
    xvar_name = "nino34"
  ) %>%
    mutate(spec = label)
}

# Predictions
rf_lin <- make_pred(m_lin, "Linear")
rf_p2  <- make_pred(m_p2,  "Quadratic")
rf_p3  <- make_pred(m_p3,  "Cubic")

# Combine
rf_all <- bind_rows(rf_lin, rf_p2, rf_p3) %>%
  mutate(spec = factor(spec, levels = c("Linear", "Quadratic", "Cubic")))

# Plot
ggplot(rf_all, aes(x = nino34, y = response)) +
  geom_line(color = "cornflowerblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "cornflowerblue", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~spec, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "NINO3.4 Index",
    y = "Estimated Effect on Price Growth"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)
ggsave("../figures/plots/ED_nonlin_price.pdf")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
  panel.id = c("Region", "Year")
)

#--- Predictions ---

                              ref = 0, step.length = 0.01,
                              xvar_name = "nino34") %>%
  mutate(spec = "Linear")

rf_p2 <- useful::predict_poly(m_p2, "nino34", min = -1, max = 2,
                             ref = 0, step.length = 0.01,
                             xvar_name = "nino34") %>%
  mutate(spec = "Quadratic")

rf_p3 <- useful::predict_poly(m_p3, "nino34", min = -1, max = 2,
                             ref = 0, step.length = 0.01,
                             xvar_name = "nino34") %>%
  mutate(spec = "Cubic")

rf_all <- bind_rows(rf_lin, rf_p2, rf_p3)

#--- Plot ---
ggplot(rf_all, aes(x = nino34, y = response)) +
  geom_line(color = "cornflowerblue", size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "cornflowerblue", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~spec, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "NINO3.4 Index",
    y = "Estimated Effect on Famine Start Probability"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)
ggsave("../figures/plots/nonlinearity_onset.pdf", device = cairo_pdf)
```
